_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: Scan by photo opens the camera again, to take a photo of the label. Upload photo still lets you choose photos you've already taken.
Stronger, clearer buzzes: one short buzz when a pallet is added and a double buzz for a warning, so you can tell without looking (Settings › Vibrate).
